note: Set A correctly distinguishes between the gable finish (P3) and attachment (L-bracket), whereas Set B conflates them into 'P3 STEEL L-BRACKET'. Set B also incorrectly identifies the mortar as the backsplash material rather than the adhesive. Both sets share significant errors: they hallucinate a 'direction E' condition for the substrate slope and misbind the 3/4" MDF dimension to the edge strip instead of the gable. Set A is preferred for having fewer misbindings and vague entities.
remarks: Both sets hallucinated 'direction E' for the substrate slope, likely confusing the text with the grid line label 'E' visible on the left margin. Both sets also misread the proximity of '3/4" MDF GABLE' and 'EDGE STRIP', attributing the MDF material and thickness to the edge strip.
